name: semantic_search
description: Local semantic search over the SHARED wiki (at the omni-dir root) AND the channel messages, backed by Qdrant. The plugin computes embeddings itself with a LOCAL vectorizer (feature-hashing by default, optional in-process fastembed/ONNX model) - no LLM and no embedding API is ever called. Provides semantic_search (wiki hits with provenance), semantic_search_index (idempotent wiki index), semantic_search__messages (message hits with channel/thread/author/date context), semantic_search_messages_index (read-only DB indexing) and stats tools.

config_schema.label: Qdrant URL
config_schema.description: Base URL of the Qdrant HTTP API (e.g. http://qdrant:6333). Defaults to the QDRANT_URL environment variable.

config_schema.label: Qdrant API Key
config_schema.description: Optional Qdrant API key (sent as the api-key header). Leave empty for an unauthenticated local Qdrant.

config_schema.label: Collection
config_schema.description: Qdrant collection name holding the wiki chunks.

config_schema.label: Corpus Roots
config_schema.description: Comma-separated corpus roots, absolute or relative to OMNI_DIR. The wiki is shared at the omni-dir root, so the default is 'wiki'.

config_schema.label: Corpus Globs
config_schema.description: Comma-separated glob patterns matched inside every corpus root.

config_schema.label: Embedding Backend
config_schema.description: LOCAL embedding backend: 'hash' (deterministic stdlib feature hashing, 384 dims, zero downloads) or 'fastembed' (in-process ONNX model, requires the fastembed package).

config_schema.label: Embedding Model
config_schema.description: Model name for the fastembed backend (ignored by the hash backend). 384 dimensions.

config_schema.label: Chunk Size (chars)
config_schema.description: Maximum characters per indexed markdown chunk.

config_schema.label: Chunk Overlap (chars)
config_schema.description: Character overlap between consecutive chunks of the same section.

config_schema.label: Batch Size
config_schema.description: Number of points per Qdrant upsert batch.

config_schema.label: Default Result Limit
config_schema.description: Default number of hits returned by semantic_search.

config_schema.label: Database URL
config_schema.description: Postgres URL of the omniagent database, read with SELECT-only access by the messages indexing tools (never written to). Defaults to the DATABASE_URL environment variable.

config_schema.label: Messages Collection
config_schema.description: Qdrant collection name holding the embedded channel messages.

config_schema.label: Excluded Message Types
config_schema.description: Comma-separated msg_type values excluded from the messages index (agent-internal bookkeeping noise).

config_schema.label: Max Chars per Message
config_schema.description: Messages longer than this are truncated (with a marker) before embedding.

config_schema.label: Min Chars per Message
config_schema.description: Messages shorter than this are not indexed.
